sentences.text:
This appeal by the claimants is directed against the impugned Judgment and Award dated 03.04.2013 passed in LAC No.781/2011 by the Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Athani filed under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, whereby the reference Court enhanced the compensation payable in favour of the appellant/claimants by fixing the rate NC:
2023:KHC-D:10420-DB at Rs.3,00,000/- per acre except 'pot kharab' together with interest and other statutory benefits.

entities.text: Shri.Peerappa vs Karnataka Neravari Nigam Ltd
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The material on record discloses that pursuant to reference under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, the subject lands of the appellants bearing Sy.No.45/1B measuring 1 acre 26 guntas, Sy.no.45/1 measuring 1 acre 4 guntas and Sy.No.45/1A measuring 2 acre 2 guntas of Nandeshwar village, taluka Athani were acquired by the 2nd respondent/SLAO for the purpose of construction of canal under the Hipparagi Barrage Project under the preliminary notification dated 12.04.2007 and awarded on 21.04.2010 fixing the market value of the lands at Rs.1,31,263/- per acre was not called in question for re-determination before the reference Court, which enhanced the compensation to Rs.3,00,000/- per acre in favour of the appellants.

According to the appellants,
they are entitled to enhanced compensation at the rate of Rs.5,00,000/- per acre as held by this Court in the case of Karnataka Neeravari Nigam Ltd., vs. The Special Land Acquisition officer and others, MFA.No.101083/2016 and connected matters dated 29.01.2021 which has been subsequently followed in MFA.No.101403/2016 (LAC) disposed NC: 2023:KHC-D:10420-DB of on 17.04.2021 in respect of very same Hipparagi-Project.

entities.text: Karnataka Neeravari Nigam Ltd., vs. The Special Land Acquisition officer and others, MFA.No.101083/2016 and
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Under these circumstances, the appellants are before this Court by way of the present appeal.

3. A perusal of the Judgment of this Court passed in MFA.No.101083/2016 and connected matters will indicate that the Division Bench of this Court vide final order dated 29.01.2021 has dismissed the appeals preferred by the Karnataka Neervari Nigam Limited, HBC Division, Athani,
District-Belagavi and confirmed the Judgment and Award passed by the reference Court, which had fixed the compensation at the rate of Rs.5,00,000/- per acre.

The said Judgment and Award passed by this Court in MFA.No.101083/2016 and connected matters was followed by this Court in the case of Shri Sangappa Pandappa Lingaraddi and others vs. The Special Land Acquisition Officer and another, MFA.No.101403/2016 (LAC) disposed of on 17.04.2021.
4.

entities.text: Shri Sangappa Pandappa Lingaraddi and others vs. The Special Land Acquisition Officer and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, we are of the considered opinion that the compensation payable in the instant case is also to be fixed at Rs.5,00,000/- per acre in NC:
2023:KHC-D:10420-DB favour of the present appellant/claimants by modifying the impugned Judgment and Award passed by the reference Court.
5.
A perusal of the impugned Judgment and Award will also indicate that the reference Court has not awarded the compensation towards lands which are classified as pot kharab.

The said finding recorded by the reference Court is contrary to the various judgments of this Court including the case of Sri Shivappa Prabhappa Mugalolli Vs The General Manager, UKP, Bagalkote, Writ Petition No.106515/2015.
6.

entities.text: Sri Shivappa Prabhappa Mugalolli Vs The General Manager, UKP, Bagalkote
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Under these circumstances, the non-grant of compensation in relation to the subject lands insofar as it includes pot kharab is concerned, also deserves to be set aside and the appellants are entitled to compensation in respect of pot kharab lands also.

In the result, we pass the following :
ORDER (i) Appeal is allowed in part with cost.

Appellants are entitled to compensation at the rate of Rs.5,00,000/- per NC: 2023:KHC-D:10420-DB acre for the entire subject land including pot kharab lands together with statutory benefits, interest, additional market value, solatium,
